insights_field_locks.description: Paths excluded from AI overwrite when POST /api/entries/{id}/analyze runs with preserve_locked_fields true: top-level summary, sentiment_score; whole insights object via insights; per-field via insights.key_points, insights.projects, insights.goals, insights.blockers, insights.people, insights.priorities, insights.themes. On PATCH /api/entries/{id}, partial insights updates skip locked paths; remove a path from this list in the same request (or earlier) to edit that field again.
